expected_response_inputs: JSON payloads from Session 1 and Session 2 launch pages
JSONL files containing one wrapped or direct payload per line
CSV exports with response_json, payload, body, data, or json columns

primary_gate.complete_case_requirement: Participant must have usable Session 1 exposure and Session 2 recognition rows for all five analysis arms: orange_flowers, hanging_clothes, aerial_beach, city_street, storm_beach.
pass_conditions: Pooled primary_positive recognition accuracy exceeds hard_negative_control recognition accuracy.
orange_flowers recognition accuracy exceeds pooled hard_negative_control recognition accuracy.
hanging_clothes recognition accuracy exceeds pooled hard_negative_control recognition accuracy.
Pooled primary_positive, orange_flowers, and hanging_clothes accuracies are above chance.
Pooled primary_positive versus hard_negative_control two-proportion z-test has two-sided p < 0.05.

exclusion_policy: Manual dry-run or shakedown participant IDs/prefixes are passed through --exclude-participant-id or --exclude-participant-prefix.
Participants missing Session 1 or Session 2 payloads are not usable for the gate.
Form mismatches between sessions are excluded with reason form_mismatch.
Session 1 media_error or incomplete exposure excludes the matched analysis trial.
Session 2 left_media_error, right_media_error, or any_media_error excludes the matched recognition trial.
Participants without all five usable analysis arms are excluded from the complete-case primary gate.
claim_boundary: This plan and script do not create human-memory evidence.
Underpowered, dry-run, media-error, missing-session, and incomplete-case outputs are not human memorability evidence.
Only a passed delayed Session 2 analysis can support a human recognition-memory claim for the primary pockets.
